newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU agrees Euro legal status, ERM2 - de Silguy.
newsitem.headline: EU agrees Euro legal status, ERM2 - de Silguy.

text.p: European Monetary Affairs Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy said on Monday EU finance ministers had agreed on the legal status of the euro and a new exchange rate mechanism linking European currencies to the euro.
"We have agreed on all the legal texts," he told reporters.
These covered the legal status, the ERM2 and a budget stability pact, only the last of which was controversial.
Dutch Finance Minister Gerrit Zalm earlier told reporters EU finance ministers had agreed on a stability pact limiting budget deficits after the launch of the single currency.
The legal status establishes a one to one relationship between the euro and the existing European Currency Unit (ECU) and lays down a framework for conversion of contracts.
The ERM2 will limit fluctuations betweent the euro and European currencies waiting to join monetary union.
